title: Bigfoot Bash tells the tale of Sasquatch at sighting area
excerpt: Have you ever spotted Bigfoot? Maybe you took the time to learn about him Saturday evening.
content:
Kyle Wills

Sun, September 20, 2026 at 1:28 AM UTC

1 min read

LAKE MILTON, Ohio (WKBN) -- Have you ever spotted Bigfoot? Maybe you took the time to learn about him Saturday evening.

Saturday was the first-ever Bigfoot Bash at Halliday's Winery.

Attendees enjoyed cocktails and a meet-and-greet with Sasquatch before taking part in a trail walk.

There was trivia, and you could even learn the lore of Bigfoot.

Organizers say there have been sightings in the area dating back to the 1970s. They say it was a great turnout and want to make this an annual event.

"The Lake Milton Historical Society is all about bringing the community together, trying to promote the history of Lake Milton and community involvement," Matthew Wagner with the historical society said.

All proceeds from the event benefit the Lake Milton Historical Society.

Alex Sorrells contributed to this report.
